anchors: one rep0 per each of the 10 sorted test families; alternate frames 40 and 80
perturbation: reverse translation with [-1,1] clipping and flip gripper to the opposite extreme; rotation unchanged
restore: replay recorded physical action prefix and restore pre-action policy queues, temporal ensemble and RNG; verify complete original suffix
estimand: at fixed simulator and policy history advance the policy normally, replace only the first external command, then follow MINERVA to success or original time limit
reference_rule: paired percentile bootstrap 95% interval for the mean difference must lie entirely beyond +/-0.005 and at least six of eight paired differences must have the winning sign
ranking: per seed average correct over evaluable pairs at each anchor, then equal weight across evaluable anchors; report all three seeds and their mean; ties count as one half
q_error: all 30 anchor-action cells weighted equally, compare each frozen Q with the reference mean, report RMSE MAE and signed bias as well as V-only baseline and reference standard errors
uncertainty: 10000 bootstrap draws; paired references within each anchor, cluster outer resampling by test family; descriptive intervals with only 10 families
